question: For Atezolizumab trials, bucket the publication year into: ≤2014, 2015–2018, ≥2019.

steps.desc: Filter trials using Atezolizumab and select the publication year.
Bucket publication year into defined categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read the Year and output a JSON {NCT, PMID, Author, year_group} where year_group is one of ["<=2014", "2015-2018", ">=2019", "unknown"]. Rules: If Year is null or not a number, year_group is "unknown". If Year <= 2014, year_group is "<=2014". If Year is between 2015 and 2018 inclusive, year_group is "2015-2018". If Year >= 2019, year_group is ">=2019". Output JSON only.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
